author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
On Adam's first day back from a monthlong vacation, he unboxes a few items that arrived at the workshop, including an impressively sized circle drawing tool, a practical bike helmet mirror accessory, and a stunning prop replica from Hellboy 2! Made by RelicMaker on the Replica Prop Forum, this gold-plated Crown of Bethmora replica has exactly the kind of heft Adam likes in a prop. Let's see if it fits!

Adam's Hellboy Mechaglove build: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HJd4sJfpOLU
Relic Maker Crown of Bethmora replica: https://www.etsy.com/listing/4571985389/hellboy-2-crown-of-bethmora-crown-of-the
WindFire Designs Circle Tools: https://windfiredesigns.com/Tools/CircleTool/index.html
Safe Zone helmet mirror: https://www.efficientvelo.com/tools/safe-zone-helmet-mirror-1

Shot by Adam Savage and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
